name: Zoology
boundaries: Zoology: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.original_title: Complete neuro-molecular mechanism of long-distance homing and true navigation
original_dispositions.reason: The remaining integration problem is mechanistically unsolved, but several navigation cues are already demonstrated in different taxa; a universal map-and-compass target is inappropriate for some species. A finished account of one cue pathway would not meet the stated impact bar.

original_dispositions.original_title: Dynamical rules of instantaneous collective coordination
original_dispositions.reason: A core interaction rule for starling flocks has been demonstrated, and flocking models already exist. Remaining border dynamics, neural implementation, and species-specific exceptions were judged incremental relative to the calibration set.

original_dispositions.original_title: Multi-generational navigational memory in cyclic migrants
original_dispositions.reason: The historical picture of a learned inherited map does not match the current evidence. Epigenetic memory of cue recognition remains a hypothesis; resolving it would explain one migration system.

original_dispositions.original_title: Evolutionary and molecular basis of menopause
original_dispositions.reason: Menopause and adaptive research programs are already known. A molecular switch would explain a rare life-history trait, while therapies would require further medical development.

original_dispositions.original_title: Master regulatory network for scar-free epimorphic regeneration
original_dispositions.reason: ZOO-02 covers the narrower demonstration of adult mammalian limb regeneration. A single conserved circuit for limbs, spinal cord, heart, and retina remains an additional hypothesis.

original_dispositions.original_title: Neural and molecular substrates of consciousness across phyla
original_dispositions.reason: The problem remains unresolved and consequential, but this pass did not find an empirical criterion that closes the gap between observable markers and subjective experience.

Independent evolutionary transitions have independent genetic underpinnings; repeated regulatory complexity is not an established installable module. Engineering eusociality would be a further project.

original_dispositions.original_title: Mechanisms of negligible senescence and cancer resistance in long-lived animals
original_dispositions.reason: ZOO-03 covers negligible senescence. Cancer resistance was not added: it is a comparative pattern with several partial cellular explanations, and lower cancer incidence is not a flat mortality curve.

original_dispositions.original_title: Molecular handshake by which gall-inducing insects reprogram host plants
original_dispositions.reason: This is an unfinished coevolutionary mechanism with reported candidate effectors, but an account of one lineage was judged short of a general zoological principle; a plant-engineering platform would require further work.

original_dispositions.original_title: Functional integration of extreme morphological structures
original_dispositions.reason: The examples are separate natural-history puzzles. Solving one would complete a case study rather than supply the generative theory of form represented by ZOO-09.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Preserved ZOO-01 through ZOO-10 and their completion criteria. No concept was deleted, replaced, or merged.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The first-pass concepts remain unchanged in identity.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended ZOO-02 to separate a single hypothetical master network for limb, spinal cord, heart, and retina from the limb demonstration.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical regeneration item is broader than the evidence supports.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended ZOO-03 to separate negligible senescence from cancer resistance. Cancer resistance was not given a new ID.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical item bundles distinct results.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Amended ZOO-05, ZOO-08, and ZOO-09 with short boundary sentences.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Navigation, flocking, Cambrian disparity, and odd-structure natural history should not be read into those IDs.
The historical items that are not ZOO-02 or ZOO-03 failed the revolutionary-impact test or were already partly achieved.
It does not support the claim that those ten items are an agreed 2026 priority set.
